AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  OCTOBER 23, 2019
STUDY SESSION MEETING
CITY HALL - U.S. CONSTITUTION ROOM/#4
7:00 P.M.

REGULAR MEETING
  7:30 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Scott D. Collins, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Victor Juan, Planning Commissioner
  Linda Lopez, Planning Commissioner
  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
  other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
  Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
  Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
  the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
  not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
  certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
  after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

REGULAR MEETING
 CALL TO ORDER

FLAG SALUTE  Chair Barragan

ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS

  1.  MEETING MINUTES - Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the
  Regular Meeting of October 9, 2019.

Minutes 10-9-19

PUBLIC HEARING

  2.  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 32) CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 1017
  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN NO. 2020
  SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 313 Rose Bacinski, Bacinski & Associates (“Applicant”) on behalf of Tacos
  Gavilan, Canasty Financial LLC (“Property Owner”); 10968 Rosecrans Avenue (“Subject Property”),
  also known as Assessor’s Parcel Number (APN) 8075-006-034; a request to: 1) construct a new drive-
  through restaurant and modify the existing parking layout; 2) obtain an adjustment of the parking
  requirements through the approval of a parking study; and 3) establish new signage for the proposed
  drive-through restaurant.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission:

  1)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-26 approving Conditional Use Permit No. 1017, subject to the Conditions
  of Approval, attached as Exhibit "A";

  2)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-27 approving Precise Development Plan No. 2020, subject to the
  Conditions of Approval, attached as Exhibit "A"; and

  3)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-28 approving Sign Use Permit No. 313, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval, attached as Exhibit "A".

  CUP 1017 PDP 2020 SUP 313 report

  3.  ADOPTION OF A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 178
  TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 319
  ZONE CHANGE NO. 357
  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 082678
  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN NO. 2016
  SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 310
  Angela Meyer on behalf of Brandywine Homes (“Applicant”); 13211- 13253 San Antonio Drive, 12027-
  12033 Sproul Street, and 12038 Olive Street (“Subject Property”), also known as (Assessor’s Parcel
  Numbers (“APN”) 8048-029-007 through 013); a request to allow the construction of a 27-unit
  townhome development that includes a live-work component. The application involves the following:

  1)  General Plan Amendment to add text in the General Commercial (GC) and High Density
  Residential (HDR) land use categories and amend the General Plan designation of APN 8048-
  029-007 of the project site from High Density Residential (HDR) to General Commercial (GC);

  2)  Text Amendment to amend the Zoning Ordinance to establish a Live-Work (L-W) Overlay zone and
  create regulations for said overlay zone;

  3)  Zone Change for APN 8048-029-007 from the Multi-Family High Density Residential, Parking (R-
  3(P)) zone to the General Commercial (C-3) zone; and apply the (L-W) Overlay zone to the
  Subject Property;

  4)  Subdivide the Subject Property site through a tentative tract map for condominium purposes;

  5)  Construct eleven (11) adaptable live-work townhomes and sixteen (16) townhomes, for a total of
  twenty-seven (27) townhomes at the Subject Property; and

  6)  Creation of a master sign plan for the proposed development at the Subject Property.  Staff
  Recommendation: That the Planning Commission:
   1)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-29 recommending City Council approval of General Plan
  Amendment No. 178 and adoption of the Negative Declaration;

  2)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-30 recommending City Council approval of Text Amendment No.
  319;

  3)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-31 recommending City Council approval of Zone Change No. 357;

  4)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-32 to approve Tentative Tract No. 082678 subject to the Conditions
  of Approval contained in respective Exhibit “A”;

  5)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-33 to approve Precise Development Plan No. 2016 subject to the
  Conditions of Approval contained in respective Exhibit “A”; and

  6)  Adopt Resolution No. 19-34 to approve Sign Use Permit No. 310 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval contained in respective Exhibit “A”.

  Brandywine Homes Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated October 17, 2019.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary
